extraction.notes: Quarter ended June 30, 2025 (three-month column only). Amounts in thousands. FFO and AFFO are both reported; the company has no separate adjusted FFO (Core) metric, so core fields are null. Non-controlling interest adjustment is (4) in the FFO section and nil in the AFFO section this quarter (recorded as 0). Checks: -2,566 + 6,580 + 1,436 - 4 = 5,446; 5,446 - 179 + 5 + 1,135 + 284 + 30 + 126 + 0 = 6,847. Diluted shares 18,909,000 printed in full, divided by 1,000 to 18,909 thousand; 5,446/18,909 = $0.29 and 6,847/18,909 = $0.36, matching reported per-share figures. Recurring capex: AFFO does not deduct recurring capex; the BRT share of estimated recurring capex for the quarter ($1,529,000) is from the Capital Expenditures table on printed page 11 (the table is headed quarter ended June 30, 2025). Per-share reconciliation (printed page 7) was used only for share count and per-share confirmation. Note: the printed-page-6 reconciliation was the only source for dollar amounts.
